text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Time to put my grand academy<n>takeover plan into
action!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I haven't the slightest clue what<n>she's talking
about, so I ask her to<n>explain.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I saw a movie where the<n>bad guys take
over a hotel and hold<n>all the guests hostage!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone tries their best to solve the<n>puzzles and
escape, but they totally<n>fail!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The villains were really awesome!<n>They were elite
bad guys!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just so ya know, I'm not being a<n>copycat! This is
what you call<n>inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The movie inspired me to come up<n>with my own
takeover plan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a heavy thud, she plops a thick<n>stack of
documents containing her<n>elaborate plans onto the
desk.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So? Pretty incredible, huh? This is the<n>result of my
blood, sweat, and tears!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, join me! You're my diabolical<n>strategist, so I
need ya on the team!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I'm still a little confused, but<n>hopefully reading
through her plan will<n>give me a better understanding
of<n>what she's talking about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she wants to set up<n>pranks around the
academy, seal off<n>the hallways, and announce her
takeover to the students using the PA<n>system.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The students will have to solve<n>puzzles and make
their way to the<n>location Shinko Windy is hiding in.
Once they capture her, the academy<n>will be freed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Basically, it's a surprise large-scale<n>escape game
mixed with<n>hide-and-seek.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take over the whole<n>academy and
plunge it into the depths<n>of fear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Going through with all of this is bound<n>to have
negative effects on her<n>training schedule. But on
the flip side,<n>I don't want all her effort to go to
waste...
choice_data_list: What if we reduce the scale to half the academy?
I don't think we should move forward with this...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: H-half?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's way too small! I want my<n>takeover to be a
massive deal!
choice_data_list: A smaller scale lets us focus on the details.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that the campus here at<n>Tracen Academy
is very large. As<n>such, it would be next to
impossible to<n>cast fear over the entire place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By cutting the range of our targets in<n>half, we can
focus our efforts on<n>making everything as terrifying
as<n>she likes.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hm, I getcha. Not a bad idea coming<n>from you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It would also cut down on the cost of<n>materials,
which means I can use the<n>extra money to buy
scary toys.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll buy heaps more fake bugs and<n>set up
jack-in-the-boxes all over the<n>place!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: All right! We'll go with yoursuggestion! I'm gonna take over halfof the whole academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, unbeknownst to the student<n>body, Shinko
Windy's academy<n>takeover plan is set into motion.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That positive attitude is why you're<n>my trainer!
Neeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The academy won't know what hit<n>'em!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I follow after Shinko Windy to<n>the first step
in her conquest...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking over this academy, so<n>don't make any
trouble unless ya<n>wanna get hurt!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh! We gotta take them out<n>first, so they
can't get in the way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure, but the student council isn't<n>likely to play
along...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... Very well. I'll submit your<n>proposal to the
director.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As it so happens, we've recently<n>been floating the
idea of holding some<n>kind of event for the students.
We all<n>need a bit of stimulation every now<n>and then,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And I have to say, this looks like a<n>thorough plan
with any and all<n>possible risks fully accounted for.
Well done. I hope it's a grand<n>success.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Hmph, I'm not doin' this forthe school, I'm doin' it for me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But, well... I'll take the praise! Heh<n>heh!
Heeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, unbeknownst to the student<n>body, Shinko
Windy's academy<n>takeover plan is set into motion.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You idiot! You're not supposed to say<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're just a big jerk! I don't want<n>you as my
trainer anymore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...First things first, I need to chase<n>after her and get
her to calm down.<n>Then maybe I can convince her
to see<n>things from my point of view.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"It'll affect my training"? Hmph, I<n>don't buy that
one bit!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Don't ya get how wicked awesome I<n>am?! I can
pull pranks and run races<n>at the same time, easy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I-I just said it'll be fine!<n>Whaddya mean
"what if"?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yup. A hundred... percent...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! What could possibly even go<n>wrong?! Give
me just one...<n>example...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gimme a sec! I'm gonna revise my<n>plan just a
teensy bit! I, um, just<n>came up with a new idea for
another<n>prank!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, unbeknownst to the student<n>body, Shinko
Windy's academy<n>takeover plan is set into motion...
after<n>a few minor revisions.
